json.rationale: You are on an unpaved road coming to a crossroads with a paved road. Vehicles on the paved road have right of preference of passage (preferencia de paso). So you must give way (ceda el paso) and you may go once it is clear. No vehicles are visible now, so there is nobody to wait for.
json.temptingWrongAnswer: Proceed normally because there is no traffic and no yield sign for you.
json.whyWrong: The paved road has priority over the unpaved road even without a sign. You still have the duty to give way (ceda el paso) and only go when it will not force others to brake or swerve.
